keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, no Cliopatria row: the pages give no list of the land held ('The page never gives a full list'); this is the union of the places they date. Cliopatria's Kingdom of Afghanistan shape covers the country through 1929; the ledger carves the Saqqawist land out of it.

region.text: Kabul and the Kuhdaman, Kuhistan and Ghurband areas north of it, held by Kalakani from 17 January 1929 (CW)

ledger.note: 1929: Habibullah Kalakani takes Kabul. 'On the 17th of January, Inayatullah, unnerved by the lack of support from the Kabulis, surrendered to Kalakani' (CW); HK: 17 January 1929 'the day that Kalakani captured Kabul', he had claimed the title of emir since 14 December 1928.

region.text: 'Kalakani held control of the entire Ghazni region' by late May 1929 (CW)

ledger.note: 1929: the Saqqawists hold Ghazni. 'By late May Kalakani held control of the entire Ghazni region.' The month is the page's bound ('by late May').

region.text: Kandahar, fallen to Kalakani on 31 May or 3 June 1929 (CW)

ledger.note: 1929: Kandahar falls to Kalakani's forces. Amanullah fled into British India on 23 May; Kandahar 'duly fell on 3 June or 31 May' (Faiz Mohammad 3 June, Encyclopaedia Iranica 31 May).

region.text: Mazar-i Sharif, captured by the Saqqawists in June 1929 (CW)

ledger.note: 1929: Mazar-i Sharif is captured by the Saqqawists in June (a footnote has a joint Soviet-Afghan unit taking it in April 1929). The extent beyond the city is the researcher's reading (Balkh).

region.text: Kandahar, fallen to Kalakani on 31 May or 3 June 1929 (CW)

ledger.note: 1929: Kandahar rises for Nadir. 'On 23 September, a pro-Nadir uprising in Kandahar succeeded at driving out Kalakani's forces from the city.'

wars.outcome: Habibullah Kalakani overthrew Amanullah in January 1929 and held Kabul until Nadir Khan took the Arg on 13 October 1929.

certainty.note: A civil-war regime with moving fronts; the pages date the cities, not the districts.

sources.title: Habibullah Kalakani
sources.note: Reign 17 January - 13 October 1929; claimed the emir's title from 14 December 1928; Amanullah's flight; Nadir took Kabul 13 October; executed 1 November 1929.

sources.title: Afghan Civil War (1928-1929)
sources.note: Kabul 17 January 1929; Ghazni by late May; Kandahar 31 May or 3 June, lost 23 September; Mazar-i Sharif June; Herat disputed; Nadir in the Arg 13 October.

notes: Written for batch ia-03-x from two pages (HK, CW; budget 1-2 for a one-year state). The kingdom-of-afghanistan dossier (ia-03-f) carries the matching losses in 1929/1 (Kabul and Parwan), 1929/6 (Kandahar), 1929/9 and 1929/10; it has none for Ghazni and Mazar-i Sharif, which CW supports and which should be added there. Herat: CW's sources disagree (captured before 15 May by mutineers from Mazar, or after Mazar fell in June); no event is recorded for it. Parwan is not named as held on CW; Kuhdaman and Kuhistan lie in the Kabul-Parwan area.
